parts.text: $COP Q3 2026: lower 48 was the largest line at 68% of revenue. Revenue $19.4B, operating margin 30.8%. Net earnings $4.0B. Suggested opening: operating profit grew faster than sales, +104% vs +29%. What do you make of it? #earnings #oil
$ARW: operating profit grew faster than sales, +140% vs +39%. Q3 revenue reached $10.7B, led by AI-related demand in components. 👇 #earnings #industrials
$CMI (preliminary): operating profit grew faster than sales — revenue +14% to $9.4B, operating margin 15.3%. Q3 net earnings $1.1B. 👇 #earnings #industrials
$PH (preliminary): sales grew 18% to $6.0B in Q1, led by double-digit organic growth and the Filtration Group acquisition. Net earnings rose to $884M. 👇 #earnings #industrials
$LNC: profit is growing faster than sales — revenue +20% to $5.5B, operating margin 25.5% (preliminary). Q3 net earnings reached $1.3B. 👇 #earnings #insurance
$OSCR: fast top-line growth met higher profitability — Q3 2026 revenue +72% Y/Y to $5.1B with a 3.4% operating margin (preliminary). 👇 #earnings #insurance
$KMB: flat sales and lower margins — revenue $4.1B (-0%), operating margin 12.5%. Q3 preliminary results hit by discrete headwinds. 👇 #earnings #materials
$AJG: operating profit grew faster than sales, +49% vs +18%. Q3 revenue hit $4.0B. 👇 #earnings #insurance
$VTRS: flat revenue but still losing money — Q3 net loss of $325M on $3.7B revenue, alongside $899M in operating cash flow. 👇 #earnings #pharma
$APD (preliminary): profit grew faster than sales as operating income jumped on project exits and pricing. Q4 FY26 revenue $3.6B (+12% Y/Y), operating margin 17.8%. 👇 #earnings #materials
$YUMC: Food and Non Food Revenues From Sales delivered 80% of the $271.0M revenue gain (+7% Y/Y). Q3 2026 revenue $3.5B (+8% Y/Y). Operating margin 13.0%. 👇 #earnings #restaurants
$TAP: cash came in ahead of profit — operating cash flow $460M, 169% of net earnings. Q3 revenue $3.4B (−2% Y/Y). 👇 #earnings #beverages
